live.title: Live session
live.estimateNote: Estimate without attributable operating minutes and additional flow items.

setup.title: Meter not set up
setup.description: Energy billing is enabled, but no session can start until this resource's flow defines its meter.

problems.ready-unreachable: Connect "Metering start" to a "Metering ready" node.
problems.report-unreachable: Connect "Metering collection" to a "Report energy" node.

pending.title: Energy charge pending
pending.description: Usage #{{usageId}} has ended and its base charge is billed. The energy consumption is still missing because there was no valid meter reading when it ended.

failed.title: Energy charge failed
failed.description: A later session has used the meter since, so the consumption of usage #{{usageId}} can no longer be measured.

unsettled.retryHint: Reads the meter once more. On success the consumption is billed as an additional correction transaction; the existing bill stays unchanged.
unsettled.waiveHint: The consumption is not billed and no transaction is created. This notice disappears.

retried.title: Energy billed
retried.description: The meter was read and the consumption was billed as a correction transaction.

waived.title: Energy charge waived
waived.description: No energy will be billed for this usage.
